$description: Logo tones: overrides of the semantic logo roles for a given surface. Values are DERIVED by the build (scripts/brand/build-tokens.mjs): each role listed under `syd.tone.minContrast` is lightened in OKLCH (hue and chroma kept) just enough to reach the ratio against the tone's surface. Explicit $value entries are used as-is.

on-dark.$description: Logo on the inverse (night-blue) surface of the active theme: footer, CTA bands. A container with class surface-inverse applies it (logoTone in the theme), so the logo needs no tone prop there.

tab-dark.$description: The favicon (leaf + S) in a dark browser tab: icon.svg switches to it under prefers-color-scheme: dark. Ratios a step above on-dark: at 16-32 px every facet must read.
